posts.title: What limits a drone swarm's view? Seven constraints, from placement to flight
posts.summary: Seven constraint axes on twelve corridor and corner maps: grid-certified placement, interactions, a static estimator check and 108 flight episodes. Why sensing, standoff and swarm size mattered most—and why safety failures and observation loss stay in the results.

posts.title: Airborne trajectories and time to zone entry: GRU, LSTM, TCN and MLP
posts.summary: 21 synthetic motion profiles, 840 generated runs, 24 validation-only tuning trials and 12 final fits. Compare four model families, baseline coverage, non-entry tracking errors and streaming cost, with a regenerated C++ GRU reference.

posts.title: BrowserLens: finding where a browser agent stopped making progress
posts.summary: Submitted to the UIST 2026 Posters track. Why complete logs can still hide navigation loops and ineffective actions, how BrowserLens reorganizes a run around browser state, and what the prototype has yet to establish.

posts.title: Reducing browser-agent token use: progressive disclosure and context design
posts.summary: An empirical study of observation reduction in a browser agent. Across 20 paired tasks, adaptive element disclosure showed no measurable benefit, while pruning per-link URL attributes reduced token use by approximately 22%. Context audits and revised success evaluation explain how the interpretation changed.
